text.hero_kicker: A CAMPAIGN OF THE JUST TRUST
text.hero_tagline: BUILDING A FUTURE WE'RE PROUD OF
text.about_body: Justice & The Next 250 is a campaign of The Just Trust, inviting Americans to look ahead to the future of justice and safety in the country. For the entirety of 2026 — the year marking the 250th birthday of the United States of America — we're bringing together advocates, culture-makers, policymakers, and community leaders to shift the conversation from what's broken to what's possible.
text.why_p1: For decades, the criminal justice reform field has done the essential work of documenting harm, exposing failure, and naming injustice. That work changed public awareness, shifted policy debates, and built a shared understanding that the system must do a far better job of delivering on both safety and justice.
text.why_p2: Because of that work, we are no longer in a moment of discovery.
text.why_p3: In the year marking America's 250th birthday, the question before us is no longer whether the system needs to change. The question is what we are building next. Justice & The Next 250 is an invitation to shift our collective focus to what CAN BE, and to lead the way there.
text.why_know2: We know the impact of that brokenness.
text.why_know3: And we know that the status quo does not deliver safety, accountability, or dignity. The things literally everyone wants.
text.blog_lede: Blog posts, news, and event recaps from the campaign — new posts publish here all year.
text.involved_title: HOW WILL YOU SHAPE THE NEXT 250?
text.involved_p1: This summer, let's showcase what's working, and what can be scaled, strengthened, and sustained in the years ahead.
text.involved_p2: We invite you to engage with Justice & The Next 250 in ways that make sense for your work, audiences, and this particular moment. Here are ways to participate.
text.host_intro: Hosting a Justice & The Next 250 event is an opportunity to bring people together to talk about what you're doing to shape the next 250. The format, the audience, the discussions — that's up to you. The only requirement is that you look ahead, and talk about what your organization is doing to lead the way forward.
text.host_card1_body: Convene a gathering centered on shaping the next 250. Take a moment for where we’ve been, but spend most of your time on where we’re going. Your event should reflect your community and expertise—not a prescribed agenda. We’re here to help with planning, branding resources, promotion, and more. Share your event details with us early so we can list it on the site, amplify it across our channels, and support you as your plans take shape.
text.host_card2_body: Choose a format that fits your community: a town hall, dinner, webinar, fundraiser, community conversation, or another forward-looking gathering.
text.host_card3_body: Document the ideas, stories, and commitments that emerge, then share them with the campaign so others can learn from your community. Click the “Tell us about your event” button below so we can support and help amplify your event.
text.events_lede: Find campaign gatherings across the country, from community conversations and leadership convenings to film screenings and public programs.
text.feature_body: Campaign participants can host an exclusive advance screening before the series airs in November. You'll receive a roughly 50-minute clip, a discussion guide, and marketing materials. We can also connect you with your local PBS station to explore an event partnership.
text.media_title: JUSTICE & THE NEXT 250 OUT IN THE WORLD
text.media_lede: Follow films, conversations, event moments, and community stories from across the campaign — wherever they are shared.
text.newsletter_title: STAY IN THE LOOP FOR THE NEXT 250.
text.newsletter_body: Campaign updates, new events, and fresh media — straight to your inbox. No noise.
